mission.title: Opportunity Knocks
mission.description: Search for the documents Morpheus has been hiding.

npc.say: We got a lot of vacation time though. I wouldn't worry about it.
I don't know if I'm happy here... The hours are long and the benefits suck.

phase.briefing:
It seems Morpheus discovered a way to damage the Matrix -- internally. This ability of his is a threat to our very existence... However, if we control that ability we could become quite powerful; perhaps powerful enough to take control of the Matrix from within. Information can be found that will aid us uncover the methods that Morpheus is using.
The Merovingian requires this information, which is why we are sending you in. We want you to visit this location and search the place for documents, files, anything that can help us shed more light on this newfound ability of his. Is this clear? Good. Do it.

enter.say: Listen up, {player}. It appears Morpheus has been stashing documents at this location. Keep in mind that this is a Zion operated area so you will run into opposition.
Be sure to search your fallen opponents for objects or items that might be of help to us.

objective.text: Get the key from the Zion Ballista

done.say: I bet that key goes to the filing cabinet...

objective.text: Search the filing cabinet for Morpheus' documents

done.say: The documents might be inside this filing cabinet.
That must be what Morpheus was hiding here. Take the document!
Wait a minute, this isn't what we're looking for... I'm going to look over it.

phase.briefing:
It appears you found yet another address to yet another location... I tire of this.
I'm sending you there now to continue your search. Get moving.

enter.say: This is a Machine controlled office complex that acts as a front for some of their operations. I can only assume the Machines stole the document from Morpheus. Search the whole place; from corner to corner. Leave no filing cabinet closed and no safe unlocked!

objective.text: Get the key from the Agent

done.say: This key could be what we need to find the stolen data.

objective.text: Search the place for documents from Morpheus

done.say: That file that you just picked up states that the data stolen from Morpheus is hidden in a safe here.
You just set off the security alarm! Guards are headed your way right now!

objective.text: Get the disk from the safe

done.say: That's what we were looking for. Take the disk!
I'll download that from you now...

mission.finish:
Another one of our missions draws in an end. The light at the end of this tunnel is quite intriguing.
I shall be in contact with you, {player}.
